Every `id` is an integer past 2^53 and some are NEGATIVE (-5099382229872932738), so a JSON.parse rounds it and it cannot be an identity. `updated` carries no zone (2026-11-13T00:00:00.0000000). `link` is a jooble.org/away/ or /desc/ redirect, never the employer page. `type` is often the empty string; `salary` and `source` are present and not mapped. Terms (https://jooble.org/info/terms, effective 2019-01-08, read 2026-11-16) are site terms with no API clause: section 4(i) forbids copying content for republication without permission, 4(m) forbids bots or automatic access to the Site, 9(d) allows linking; the key itself is granted by Jooble for API access. Section 4(m) forbids bots on the website; the adapter uses the keyed REST API, the sanctioned access path, and never the website. Taken by the owner-authorized controlled authenticated smoke (workflow verify-job-source-credentials.yml, run 43964860057, ONE request per source); the key travelled in a header, or (Jooble only) in the path of a request URL that was never logged, and the script refuses to keep a body or header in which the key appears. permission KEY_REQUIRED: the source answers only with the CRM's own key, which the runtime checks before every run. E-mail addresses and phone numbers inside string values were replaced by a parser; personal NAMES in free-text descriptions cannot be found by a parser and were not redacted.
